summary: Completed frontend testing of A5.2 gated section in FAIRA Assessment Form. All A5.2 subsections (A5.2a-e) render correctly when 'Yes' is selected, hide when 'No' is selected, and all form fields are functional.
passed_tests: A5.2 conditional subsections appear only when 'Yes' is selected
A5.2 conditional subsections hide when 'No' is selected

A5.2a multiselect checkboxes work correctly (ai inputs, ai outputs, human decisions informed by ai, automated actions triggered by ai, model version/configuration, data sources used/provenance, access to outputs/disclosures, Other (specify))
A5.2a 'Other (specify)' checkbox reveals conditional input field when checked
A5.2a 'Other (specify)' input field accepts text input

A5.2b multiselect checkboxes work correctly (application/system logs, dedicated audit logs, workflow/case management records, database records, centralised logging/siem, manual records, not in place/unknown, Other (specify))
A5.2c dropdown (retention period) works correctly with options: less than 30 days, 30-90 days, 3-12 months, more than 12 months, unknown/not defined

A5.2d dropdown (access scope) works correctly with options: restricted operational staff only, security/risk/audit teams, system administrators, external auditors/regulators, broad internal access, unknown/not defined
A5.2e optional notes textarea works correctly
Progress bar correctly updates when A5.2 fields are filled (0% -> 3%)
A5 section progress indicator updates correctly (0% -> 8%)
Auto-save works with A5.2 subsections (timestamp visible)
Save Draft button works with success toast confirmation
Form data persists when navigating away (to A1) and back to A5 section
critical_code_review_comments: A5.2 gated section correctly implemented with Yes/No radio buttons
Conditional rendering of subsections (A5.2a-e) works correctly using form.A5_2 === 'Yes' check
A5.2a and A5.2b use toggleInArray function for multiselect checkboxes
A5.2c and A5.2d use update function for single-select dropdowns
A5.2e uses update function for textarea
A5_2_notes field is correctly excluded from progress calculation as it's optional
Progress calculation in FairaAssessmentForm.js correctly accounts for A5.2 conditional fields
Scoring schema (faira_scoring_schema.json) correctly defines A5_2 as 'yes_no_with_subsections' type with modifiers
seed_data_creation: Created new FAIRA assessment during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: A5.2 gated section is fully functional. The gate question shows Yes/No radio buttons. When 'Yes' is selected, 5 subsections appear: A5.2a (multiselect checkboxes for logged items with 'Other' option), A5.2b (multiselect checkboxes for logging mechanisms with 'Other' option), A5.2c (dropdown for retention period), A5.2d (dropdown for access scope), A5.2e (optional notes textarea). When 'No' is selected, all subsections hide. Progress tracking and auto-save work correctly.
